end.summary: Practised shared responsibility for keeping school clean, green, and safe.
end.parentNote: Anika practised naming everyday actions such as using dustbins, cleaning the board, and watering plants, and explained that everyone shares responsibility for cleanliness. They sorted some waste examples, but continued to mix up compostable and non-compostable items: plastic, foil, and plastic spoons do not turn into soil in a compost pit; this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise sorting a few household items into wet/green-bin and dry/blue-bin groups, explaining why each belongs there.
